thread:
jamal: heads-up: ran into surprise behavior in the Go SDK where errors come back as plain string with http status in logs only. makes programmatic handling in our sample app awkward.

priya: can you share the minimal reproduction?

jamal: created a mini quickstart that calls /v1/generate with an expired token. SDK returns `error: request failure` and we only see 401 in the transport layer. no typed error or code.

marta: this is a common pain. we should have a single error contract surfaced from server -> HTTP body -> SDK so every language can raise a typed exception. otherwise each SDK implements brittle heuristics.

jamal: my wishlist: (1) stable `code` values (e.g., TOKEN_EXPIRED, INVALID_API_KEY, RATE_LIMIT), (2) structured `retry_after` and `details`, (3) a base type `RedwoodError` with derived types `AuthError`, `RateLimitError`, `ValidationError`, `ServerError`.

priya: +1. small note about streaming: when the event stream dies due to auth, the client currently emits EOF with no context. need StreamError and include `last_event` and `status`.

marta: also recommend that the SDKs expose helpers: `isRetriable(err)`, `shouldRefreshToken(err)` so app code can be tiny. and default retry policy: retry 429 and 5xx; never retry 401/403 unless refresh attempted.

jamal: agree re: helpers. For quickstarts, show examples: JS snippet in readme -> `try { await client.chat.create(...) } catch (err) { if (err.code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED') { await auth.refresh(); return client.retry(); } if (isRetriable(err)) { await backoff(); } }`

priya: backwards compatibility question: some existing customers parse `message` text. we should keep `message` human-friendly but add machine `code`. and publish a migration note.

marta: propose error JSON shape for API responses (so SDKs can parse reliably): `{"error_type":"AuthError","code":"TOKEN_EXPIRED","status":401,"message":"Token expired","retriable":false,"metadata":{"expiry":"2026-03-22T12:00:00Z"}}`

jamal: also callout for CI: add a test matrix in our SDK pipelines that spins up a mock error router returning every shape (auth, rate limit, validation, 5xx, streaming disconnect) so we detect regressions.

priya: action items: jamal will open a short spec PR with canonical codes + examples for streaming by EOD Wed. marta will add SDK helper prototypes and a test plan. I'll update two quickstarts to show catch-handling patterns.

devex-bot: reminder set - `sdk-error-contract` assigned to jamal due in 3 days.

jamal: thanks all. one UX detail: include `raw` or `body` in SDK exceptions so when users post issues they can paste the raw payload. keep `message` clean for logs.

marta: noted. will include `raw` on error objects behind a flag (default on for dev builds).

priya: perfect. will follow up with PR links in this thread when ready.

jamal: dropping an initial draft link later. thanks :raised_hands:
